overall: The AG found no violation: no evidence a quorum deliberated the interim superintendent or recording secretary appointments outside a meeting, though it reminded the committee to name known candidates in posted topics.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of the committee discussed and decided on the interim superintendent and recording secretary appointments before the July 22 and July 28 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that a quorum of the Committee discussed these appointments outside of a meeting.

allegations.summary: Chair knew the candidates' names before posting the July 22 and July 28 notices, but the notices listed only generic topics; the AG reminded the committee of notice specificity.
allegations.key_passage: We remind the Committee, however, that because Chair Lazo knew the identities of these candidates prior to posting the July 22 and July 28 meeting notices, their names should have been included in the posted discussion topics.
